scientific_integrity: The proof supplies exact algebraic identities and coarea-circle dynamics. The included checker uses finite rational cross-checks and is not a substitute for infinite proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Axisymmetric equilateral-base tetrahedra and a fixed interior axial point only. Rotation increments are implicit; general tetrahedra and exhaustive higher-period classification are not treated.
title: Invariant ovals and rotation dynamics of axial tetrahedral pedal iteration
